nodes.label: Mouse buttons, media keys, and other triggers outside the main keyboard grid. Add a trigger, then choose its action, suppress it, or inherit its assignment from the lower layer.
Display modes affect labels only — the key code stays the same. “US layout” shows standard letter labels for visual reference. “LHC codes” shows app-specific codes (e.g. KeyA, ArrowLeft).
